note: Ordered label rules for amount_due; the first label found (in rule order) wins. Historical totals ('totale versato', 'già corrisposto') are deliberately not labels. expects_amount: doc types whose missing amount is RECUPERARE (not silently null). v2.1: A-003 reads the label by its structure (amount noun + up to three qualifiers + ':' or 'di') and commits only when the document states ONE monetary amount ('unique_amount'): with two or more, which one is due is a guess -> no match. when.after_not: the rule does not apply when the rest of the sentence after the figure matches.

rules.rationale: for an instalment plan the actionable figure is the instalment

input.text: Importo complessivo rateizzato: € 40.982,40. Importo della rata: € 3.415,20.

when.label: importo (?:complessivo )?dovuto|totale (?:dovuto|da pagare)|somma (?:complessiva )?di|per complessivi|importo di|importo da pagare

rules.rationale: labels that introduce the amount claimed v2.1 safety: same 'after_not' as A-003 - 'somma di € 1.234,56 a Vostro favore', 'importo di € 500,00 già versato' state a figure that is not due (v2.0 read them as due)

input.text: intima di pagare la somma di € 12.380,00 oltre interessi
importo di € 500,00 già versato in data 01/09/2026.
importo dovuto: € 500,00, da versare entro cinque giorni.

tests.comment: 'da versare' is an order to pay, not a payment made

rules.rationale: generalised label: a singular amount noun (importo, somma, totale), up to three qualifiers that all mean 'what is owed' (complessivo, dovuto, a debito, da pagare, capitale, richiesto, intimato...), then ':' or 'di' and the figure; accepted only if no other monetary amount appears in the document. Any other qualifier (minimo, versato, residuo, rateizzato...) is not read: no match v2.1 safety: 'after_not' looks at the rest of the sentence after the figure - wording that says the sum was paid, is to be refunded or is a credit ('già corrisposto', 'da rimborsare a Voi', 'a Vostro favore', 'non dovuto') means the figure is not an amount due: not read. The uniqueness check also counts amounts written without decimals next to a currency word ('euro 200')

di pagare entro dieci giorni l'importo complessivo di Euro 40.700,38 oltre interessi
a corrispondere la somma capitale di € 1.250,00 entro quindici giorni
Totale a debito: Euro 6.877,15, di cui interessi per € 120,00.

tests.comment: two monetary amounts: which one is due is not certain -> no match (RECUPERARE for this type)
